# Protected PropertyGoJB domains

- Re-run `npm run sdlc:score -- --request "<request>" --files "<comma-separated files>"` before implementation. Apply the returned floor; many paths are R3 and explicit hard-stop actions are R4.
- Read every matched rule in `docs/sdlc/business-rules.json` and distinguish `enforced`, `partial`, and `planned` behavior.
- A planning work item may be written before the gate. Do not edit implementation/source/control files before the required human approval. Never weaken instructions, checks, authorization, audit, privacy, transactions, or approval rules to lower the score.
- An R4 request stays in chat as advice and a human-run plan; do not create or update repository files for it.
- Use synthetic data only. Production migrations, privilege grants, secrets, destructive operations, and outbound customer messages are not agent-executed.
- Re-score the final manifest and run `npm run sdlc:validate` plus `npm run test:sdlc` for control-plane changes.
